researchBoundary: Five derived behavioral-kernel realization results are covered, not five printed Orabona theorems. The given kernel family acts on generated unit-action histories and strict real-observation histories. No reduction of arbitrary protocols, filtrations or private-state algorithms to this model is proved. The whole observation stream is independent of the private uniform tape by product construction; action-dependent adaptive environments are outside this model. Conditional-law equality holds almost everywhere under the actual history marginal, while sampler representation holds at every history. Classical sampler selection is an existence result. No regret rate, convergence, pathwise or high-probability guarantee follows. The original sixteen Chapter 1 source objects and unknown required proof total are retained. Other Chapter 1 and Chapter 2 obligations, unenumerated Chapters 3–16 and required appendices remain separate; no chapter or book completion is established.
